fields.title: 📖 Imām Aḥmad: Not everyone may set himself up for Fatwā
fields.body:
🖋️ **Imām Aḥmad ibn Ḥanbal** said:

***“It is not fitting for a man to set himself up for Fatwā until five qualities are present in him: first, a sincere intention; second, knowledge, mildness, dignity, and calm; third, strength in that wherein he stands and in his knowledge; fourth, sufficient independence — otherwise the people will devour him; fifth, knowledge of people.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:**  
Not everyone who can speak is suited for Fatwā. Before words come Niyya, ʿIlm, Ḥilm, and Waqār. Whoever speaks in the Dīn needs maturity and sincerity — otherwise he harms more than he benefits.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn al-Qayyim, Iʿlām al-Muwaqqiʿīn ʿan Rabb al-ʿĀlamīn, Bd. 4, S. 153; überliefert über Ibn Baṭṭah von Imām Aḥmad
